name: POST /api/leadflow/enrichment/requests - Reserve and Run
description:
Holds the credits for an enrichment run and executes it - unless the requester's budget tier may not spend, in which case it holds them and raises an approval instead (AC2).

RESERVE FIRST, EXECUTE SECOND, AND NEVER EXECUTE WHAT A TIER MAY NOT SPEND. When the tier is request-only, or the estimate exceeds its bulk-approval threshold, or the estimate exceeds its daily cap, this answers `status: awaiting_approval` with `executed: false` and the blocking reason in words. Verified live: the QA operator resolves fail-closed to Canvassers and a 2-credit run came back awaiting_approval, executed false, with 'Canvassers may request only; a manager must approve it.'

BLOCKED IN TWO PLACES ON PURPOSE. sdk-data-credits refuses execute with a 409 while an approval is outstanding, and this endpoint refuses to call execute at all. That is deliberate belt-and-braces rather than duplication: the failure it prevents is spending somebody else's money, and a single guard on the far side of a network hop is one outage away from not running.

THE FINGERPRINT, NEVER THE RAW SUBJECT. Upstream keeps only a subject_fingerprint precisely so a register of everybody every tenant ever looked up cannot accumulate there, and sending the raw value would defeat that from our side. It is a SHA-256 over tenant and subject, so the same contact fingerprints identically across requests - which is what lets the result cache hit at all, and a random value per request would silently disable the no-double-charge guarantee.

EVERY CAPABILITY IS RESERVED SEPARATELY, because they settle separately: one may match, another find nothing and refund, a third hit the cache and charge nothing. A single combined reservation could not express that, and the ledger export is per request for the same reason.

DEGRADES RATHER THAN 502s. An unreachable broker answers `status: not_reserved` with each reservation carrying `reserved: false`, so the modal can say the credits were not held. A generic upstream error would tell the operator nothing they could act on.

EDGE CASES: identical validation to the eligibility endpoint - unknown capability rejected rather than dropped, business reason a closed list, empty selection refused. 201 because a request is a new record whether or not it ran.

Behind authenticate and governed on data.configure. QA: depends on register and login.

payload.notes: {{static:validate the contact points before the inspection confirmation}}

testCases.name: Several capabilities are reserved separately, because they settle separately
NEGATIVE: a capability the catalog does not know
NEGATIVE: nothing selected, so there is nothing to reserve
NEGATIVE: a business reason outside the governed list
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: capability_keys must name at least one capability
errorCases.when: capability_keys is absent, not an array, or empty

errorCases.message: unknown capability: <key>. Known: validate_phone, validate_email, find_contact_points, find_possible_profiles
errorCases.when: any key is outside the catalog

errorCases.message: purpose must be one of: Inspection lead follow-up, Existing customer service, Commercial account qualification, Data quality remediation
errorCases.when: purpose is missing or outside the governed list

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the header is absent or not Bearer

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify

errorCases.message: No policy grants this action to the caller's roles.
errorCases.when: the caller does not hold data.configure
errorCases._whyNotReproducible: MUST-64: the suite has a single identity and no second-role producer to borrow a token from.
